lines.zh: 白得像雪，我慢慢走过去。
lines.en: White as snow, I walk along slowly.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子踩在干草上，沙沙响。
lines.en: My hooves rustle through the dry grass.

lines.zh: 我甩着尾巴，赶走身上的蝇。
lines.en: I swing my tail to drive the flies off.

lines.zh: 身子重，走起来一晃一晃。
lines.en: I'm heavy, so I sway as I walk.

lines.zh: 我跟着铃铛声，慢慢往家走。
lines.en: I follow the sound of a bell slowly home.

lines.zh: 这身白毛，在草里太显眼。
lines.en: This white coat stands out badly in the grass.
Each step I dip my head, looking for tender grass.
I walk around the puddle so I don't get dirty.

lines.zh: 阳光照在我背上，有点烫。
lines.en: The sun on my back is a little too hot.

lines.zh: 我走得很稳，像一块会走的石头。
lines.en: I walk steadily, like a walking stone.

lines.zh: 河那边的草更绿，我往那边去。
lines.en: The grass across the river is greener; I head there.

lines.zh: 我走走停停，吃两口再走。
lines.en: I walk, stop, take two bites, and walk again.

lines.zh: 栅栏的影子一段一段地过去。
lines.en: The fence's shadow passes over me in segments.

lines.zh: 我的角撞到树枝，弹回来。
lines.en: My horn clips a branch and bounces back.

lines.zh: 我转过坡，看到了整片草地。
lines.en: I round the slope and see the whole meadow.
Grass wherever I go.
I stand and chew without stopping.

lines.zh: 尾巴一甩，打在自己腿上。
lines.en: My tail swings and slaps my own leg.
I look up. The clouds are moving.
My ear turns a half circle. I heard that.

lines.zh: 我把头靠在栅栏上，蹭了蹭。
lines.en: I lean my head on the fence and rub it.
I've been chewing this mouthful a long time.
This grass tastes so-so.
I half close my eyes. It's comfortable.

lines.zh: 有只蝇落在眼角，我抖了抖。
lines.en: A fly lands by my eye and I twitch.
My back itches and I can't reach it.

lines.zh: 我喘出来的气，是白色的。
lines.en: My breath comes out white.

lines.zh: 远处有人在说话，我不在意。
lines.en: People are talking far off. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我换了个方向站，太阳更好。
lines.en: I turn to face the sun better.
A herd-mate over there calls once.

lines.zh: 我站在草里，尾巴赶着蝇。
lines.en: I stand in the grass, tail swatting flies.
This white coat heats up in the sun.

lines.zh: 你站在那儿，我看了你一会儿。
lines.en: You're standing there. I watch you a while.
That bundle in your hand. Is it grass?
I'm this white. Are you white too?
You come closer and I give half a step.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛，看不到正前方。
lines.en: With these eyes I can't see straight ahead.
Touch my back and I'll stand still.

lines.zh: 你手心里那股草味，我闻到了。
lines.en: I can smell the grass on your palm.
I stand before you, chewing grass.
What are you smiling at? Is there grass on my face?

lines.zh: 别站在我后面，看不见你。
lines.en: Don't stand behind me. I can't see you.
I lower my head and my horns point your way.
I don't mind your voice.

lines.zh: 白毛上渗出一片红，很显眼。
lines.en: A red patch seeps through my white coat, plain to see.
The albino cow backs to the fence.
Don't hit me. I didn't bother you.
That knocked me unsteady.
There's red on my white coat.

lines.zh: 我喘得很重，鼻子冒白气。
lines.en: I'm panting hard, steam from my nose.
I hide among the herd.
My leg's a bit lame; I can't walk fast.
A shake of white hide and the pain scatters.
I'm not used to this sort of thing.
Wheat? Wheat is my favorite.
What's in your hand is better than the ground.
Step by step I come toward you.
Don't pull it back. I'm almost there.
I take it from your hand, very carefully.
That mouthful was very sweet.
Another handful and I won't leave.

lines.zh: 草味把我从坡那边引来了。
lines.en: The smell of grass drew me over from the slope.
Your palm smells of grass juice.
Eat this and I'll follow you.
I chew, and it's very loud.
Any more? I'm waiting.
I nudge your pocket with my nose.
Easy. I can't eat that fast.

lines.zh: 这个味道，我以前没吃过。
lines.en: I've never tasted this before.
Afterward I lick your hand.
I bump you and step back.

lines.zh: 我这双眼睛看不全，撞到你了。
lines.en: These eyes of mine don't see it all — I bumped you.

lines.zh: 我的身体太宽，挤不过去。
lines.en: I'm too wide to squeeze past.
That flattened the grass.

lines.zh: 你扶了我一把，我站住了。
lines.en: You steady me and I find my feet.
My horn nearly caught you.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我甩了甩头。
lines.en: We collided and I shook my head.

lines.zh: 我的白毛蹭到你身上了。
lines.en: My white coat rubbed off on you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地挪开，给你让路。
lines.en: I shift slowly to make way for you.
Don't slap me from behind. I kick.
That cow is on the other side of the fence.

lines.zh: 白色的皮毛在平原上太显眼。
lines.en: White hide stands out on the plains.
I rest my head against her neck.

lines.zh: 它比我矮一些，白得也淡。
lines.en: She's shorter than me and paler white.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，尾巴朝一个方向。
lines.en: We stand side by side, tails pointing one way.

lines.zh: 这里的草，够我们两个吃。
lines.en: There's grass enough here for both of us.

lines.zh: 我们两只白角在夕阳下碰了碰。
lines.en: Our two white horns touch in the sunset.

lines.zh: 两只白角，轻轻碰了一下。
lines.en: Two pale horns touched lightly.
The sun goes down and we're still here.
I could get used to days like this.
I bite down and pull upward.
There's a flower mixed in with this grass.
I chew it into a small ball.
I'll eat what's on the ground too.
My mouth is full and I want more.
It goes down easily.
This is better than the last mouthful.
I curl my tongue and pull it in.
Done. Now for the next clump.
A day with grass is a good day.
There's a clump of tender grass over there.
I see it. I just have to walk over.
The grass there hasn't been grazed.
I raise my head and get my bearings.

lines.zh: 这条路上的草，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: I don't much like the grass along this path.

lines.zh: 那片嫩草比这边的绿一层。
lines.en: That young grass is a shade greener than this.
There's water over there too.
I pick the nearest clump.
A herd-mate saw it too. Better hurry.
I set off at an easy pace.
Step by step I move that way.

lines.zh: 路上有块石头，我绕过去。
lines.en: A stone in the way; I go around it.
Almost at that clump.
Head down, I watch the grass.

lines.zh: 同伴挡在前面，我顶了顶它。
lines.en: A herd-mate blocks me. I nudge it.
A herd-mate shifts its legs to let me eat.
My nose is nearly touching it.
Two more steps and I'm there.
There's less here than it looked.
I switch to the clump beside it.
I kick out once.

lines.zh: 我这一身白，平原上最亮。
lines.en: This white coat is the brightest on the plains.

lines.zh: 我顶你一下，只是赶你走。
lines.en: One nudge from me, just to move you along.
That one, I used my horns.

lines.zh: 我踢空了，自己转了半圈。
lines.en: I miss and spin half around.
You back off, so I don't follow.
I lash out with my tail.
I only do this when I'm pushed.
Afterward I take two breaths.
All right. Don't come closer.

lines.zh: 我站在平原上，白得显眼。
lines.en: I stand on the plain, conspicuously white.
The grass around me reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，把困意甩掉。
lines.en: I shake my head to throw off the drowsiness.
The sun is right and the grass is right.

lines.zh: 有铃铛声，是从村里来的。
lines.en: A bell, coming from the village.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的，是一整片绿。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a whole field of green.
My herd-mates aren't far off.
I take two steps and eat first.

lines.zh: 我的白毛，在阳光下发光。
lines.en: My white coat glows in the sun.

lines.zh: 今天看起来是个好天气。
lines.en: Looks like a good day today.

lines.zh: 火苗燎到我的毛，焦了一块。
lines.en: Flame catches my coat and singes a patch.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，趴在地上。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and lie flat.
I sink and water goes up my nose.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀翻在草里。
lines.en: A blast throws me over in the grass.
An arrow buries in my ribs.

lines.zh: 一股冷劲钻进骨头，我直抖。
lines.en: Cold seeps into my bones and I shiver.

lines.zh: 草都被吃光了，我饿得叫。
lines.en: The grass is all gone and hunger makes me low.

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我整头都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes me and my whole head goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没了草地，我往下掉。
lines.en: The meadow is gone and I fall.
